contentText:
Anker announced a new indoor security camera that's designed to watch your yard, driveway, or front porch through a window, instead of monitoring what's inside your home. The new Anker Eufy Window Camera E10 takes a similar approach to the Wyze Window Cam that launched nearly a year ago . It installs right against a window using an including mounting sticker to reduce glare and reflections, but the camera doesn't require any weatherproofing since it's not enduring the elements outdoors.

The Eufy Window Camera E10 is available now for $79.99 through Anker's online store and Amazon , making it more than twice as expensive as the $34.98 Wyze Win …
